lines.say: Before you write any Python, you need Python itself on your computer, and a good place to write it.
lines.tts: Before you write any Python, you need Python itself on your computer, and a good place to write it.

lines.say: In the next few minutes: how to install Python, which IDE to choose, and what to do if you don't have a laptop.
lines.tts: In the next few minutes: how to install Python, which IDE to choose, and what to do if you don't have a laptop.

lines.say: A text editor, like Notepad, is just a blank page. It stores your code as plain text.
lines.tts: A text editor, like Notepad, is just a blank page. It stores your code as plain text.

lines.say: An IDE is an Integrated Development Environment. It is a complete workspace for writing code.
lines.tts: An IDE is an Integrated Development Environment. It is a complete workspace for writing code.

lines.say: It colours your code, suggests words as you type, warns you about mistakes, and helps you find bugs.
lines.tts: It colours your code, suggests words as you type, warns you about mistakes, and helps you find bugs.

lines.say: And with one click, it runs your program and shows the output, right there.
lines.tts: And with one click, it runs your program and shows the output, right there.

lines.say: That's why programmers prefer to use an IDE. It saves time and catches mistakes early.
lines.tts: That's why programmers prefer to use an IDE. It saves time and catches mistakes early.

lines.say: Installing Python means putting the interpreter on your computer. Download Python 3 from python dot org, tick Add to PATH, and check it with python, dash dash version.
lines.tts: Installing Python means putting the interpreter on your computer. Download Python 3 from python dot org, tick Add to PATH, and check it with python, dash dash version.

lines.say: Three popular IDEs. Jupyter Notebook runs code in small cells and shows graphs right below, which suits pharmacy data. PyCharm is for larger projects, and VS Code is a free, light editor from Microsoft.
lines.tts: Three popular IDEs. Jupyter Notebook runs code in small cells and shows graphs right below, which suits pharmacy data. PyCharm is for larger projects, and VS Code is a free, light editor from Microsoft.

lines.say: No laptop? No problem. Champ Lab runs Python in your browser, even on a phone, and Google Colab gives you a free notebook online.
lines.tts: No laptop? No problem. Champ Lab runs Python in your browser, even on a phone, and Google Colab gives you a free notebook online.

lines.say: You have installed Python and opened an IDE. Let's run a quick setup check.
lines.tts: You have installed Python and opened an IDE. Let's run a quick setup check.

lines.say: The first line is a comment, a note for us. In an IDE, comments appear in a different colour, so they are easy to spot.
lines.tts: The first line is a comment, a note for us. In an IDE, comments appear in a different colour, so they are easy to spot.

lines.say: This print confirms that Python is working. In an IDE, you press the Run button, and the output appears in a panel below your code.
lines.tts: This print confirms that Python is working. In an IDE, you press the Run button, and the output appears in a panel below your code.

lines.say: Here, Python adds two hundred and fifty and two hundred and fifty. If you see five hundred, calculations are working too.
lines.tts: Here, Python adds two hundred and fifty and two hundred and fifty. If you see five hundred, calculations are working too.

lines.say: The last line tells us we are ready for the course.
lines.tts: The last line tells us we are ready for the course.

lines.say: This same code runs the same way in Jupyter Notebook, PyCharm, VS Code, or Champ Lab. Only the buttons look different.
lines.tts: This same code runs the same way in Jupyter Notebook, PyCharm, VS Code, or Champ Lab. Only the buttons look different.

lines.say: A common mix-up: typing a terminal command, like python, inside Python itself. Commands like this belong in the Command Prompt, not in your code.
lines.tts: A common mix-up: typing a terminal command, like python, inside Python itself. Commands like this belong in the Command Prompt, not in your code.

lines.say: This one means the library isn't installed, or its name is misspelt. Check the spelling, then install it with pip.
lines.tts: This one means the library isn't installed, or its name is misspelt. Check the spelling, then install it with pip.

lines.say: What does IDE stand for?
lines.tts: What does IDE stand for?

lines.say: The answer is A: Integrated Development Environment. IDE stands for Integrated Development Environment: one place to write, run and fix code.
lines.tts: The answer is A: Integrated Development Environment. IDE stands for Integrated Development Environment: one place to write, run and fix code.

lines.say: Let's recap.
lines.tts: Let's recap.

lines.say: Installing Python means putting the interpreter on your computer; on Windows, tick Add python.exe to PATH.
lines.tts: Installing Python means putting the interpreter on your computer; on Windows, tick Add python.exe to PATH.

lines.say: Check your installation with python --version in Command Prompt or Terminal.
lines.tts: Check your installation with python --version in Command Prompt or Terminal.

lines.say: An IDE (Integrated Development Environment) lets you write, run and fix code in one place.
lines.tts: An IDE (Integrated Development Environment) lets you write, run and fix code in one place.
